description: This file defines a 'Config' class in PHP that extends 'BaseConfig' and provides methods to retrieve configuration settings such as GitHub URL preparation, analytics integration, navigation features, and UI options for an HTML format in a documentation generator.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A configuration class extending BaseConfig, providing methods to access various configuration options such as URLs, analytics, display features, and themes for HTML formatting in documentation.

methods.name: prepareGithubUrl
methods.description: Sanitizes and prepares a GitHub URL, ensuring it uses HTTPS and has the correct base path.

methods.name: getEditOn
methods.description: Retrieves the URL for editing, either from specific configuration values or defaults to a prepared GitHub URL.

methods.name: hasSearch
methods.description: Checks if search is enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: showDateModified
methods.description: Checks if the date modified should be displayed.

methods.name: showPreviousNextLinks
methods.description: Checks if previous/next navigation links should be shown.

methods.name: showCodeToggle
methods.description: Checks if code block toggling is enabled.

methods.name: hasAutomaticTableOfContents
methods.description: Checks if automatic table of contents is enabled.

methods.name: hasGoogleAnalytics
methods.description: Checks if Google Analytics tracking is enabled.

methods.name: getGoogleAnalyticsId
methods.description: Retrieves the Google Analytics ID.

methods.name: hasPlausibleAnalyticsDomain
methods.description: Checks if a Plausible Analytics domain is configured.

methods.name: getPlausibleAnalyticsDomain
methods.description: Retrieves the Plausible Analytics domain.

methods.name: hasPiwikAnalytics
methods.description: Checks if Piwik analytics is configured.

methods.name: getPiwikAnalyticsId
methods.description: Retrieves the Piwik analytics ID.

methods.name: getPiwikAnalyticsUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the Piwik analytics URL.

methods.name: hasPoweredBy
methods.description: Checks if the 'Powered by' attribution is enabled.

methods.name: getPoweredBy
methods.description: Retrieves the 'Powered by' attribution value.

methods.name: hasTwitterHandles
methods.description: Checks if Twitter handles are configured.

methods.name: getTwitterHandles
methods.description: Retrieves configured Twitter handles.

methods.name: hasLinks
methods.description: Checks if external links are configured.

methods.name: getLinks
methods.description: Retrieves the list of external links.

methods.name: hasRepository
methods.description: Checks if a repository URL is configured.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Retrieves the repository URL.

methods.name: hasButtons
methods.description: Checks if custom buttons are configured.

methods.name: getButtons
methods.description: Retrieves the configured buttons.

methods.name: hasLandingPage
methods.description: Checks if a landing page is configured.

methods.name: hasBreadcrumbs
methods.description: Checks if breadcrumbs are enabled.

methods.name: getBreadcrumbsSeparator
methods.description: Retrieves the separator used in breadcrumbs.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves the configured theme.

methods.name: hasThemeVariant
methods.description: Checks if a theme variant is configured.

methods.name: getThemeVariant
methods.description: Retrieves the theme variant.
